# FG-REPO-0017

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_duplicate_protected_ref_pattern_is_pattern_taken` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 同じパターンの保護ブランチの規則がすでにあります。既存の規則を変更してください。
- en: A protected branch rule with this pattern already exists. Change the existing rule instead.
- id: Aturan branch terlindungi dengan pola ini sudah ada. Ubah aturan yang sudah ada.

## 原因 (cause)

A protected ref rule was to be added (forge_db::protected_refs::create / create_decided; `POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/protected-refs`, M1 phase 8b MR8) with a pattern that equals an existing rule of the same project ignoring case (RefPattern::key, non-ASCII case included; the database backstop is the unique index protected_refs_project_pattern on lower(pattern), which folds ASCII letters only). The check runs under the project row lock, so two concurrent adds of equal patterns never both commit. Nothing was written. Until MR8 this was FG-REPO-0013 `duplicate_pattern` (400); it is a conflict with the stored rules, not a malformed request, so clients (gstn) can tell the two apart.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=duplicate_pattern` (the application check) or `reason=unique_index` (the database backstop) and `project_id`; the pattern itself is not logged. List the project's rules with `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/protected-refs` (or a privileged query on forge.protected_refs by project_id) and compare ignoring case.

## 対処 (fix)

Change the minimum push role of the existing rule (`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}/protected-refs/{rule_id}`) instead of adding a second one, or delete it first.
